item.title: You Spend a Lifetime Preparing for Old Age — But the Number Actually Staring Back Is This One
item.description: I saw an old man lying on a Shenzhen street. After I pulled the data I understood it was not an exception, it is a probability: 125 million Chinese households now contain a single person. What decides where you end up is not whether you have children — it is whether there is a second person near you at the end.
